主要内容: DISH Network Corporation issued a press release on May 29, 2013, announcing that it sent a letter to Clearwire Corporation offering to acquire all outstanding Class A shares for $4.40 per share in cash. DISH intends to commence a tender offer prior to the Clearwire stockholders' meeting on May 31, 2013. The tender offer was part of DISH's strategy to acquire assets from Clearwire, a company in the broadcasting and telecommunications industry. The announcement was made through a press release and was signed by R. Stanton Dodge, Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary of DISH Network Corporation on May 30, 2013.
